ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance and Actuarial Science majors. Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students at approximately noon November 25th. Prerequisite FIN 300 will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 300 will be removed from FIN 321. To pass Finance 321 you must pass the assessment of pre-requisite knowledge and skills exam given in the first two weeks of the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Finance or Actuarial Science major(s).
